what: A pill-shaped photo window, 70% wide, 16:9, with a 30vw corner radius, sits at the center of the screen. When the panel touches the top of the screen it is pinned, and as you scroll it widens to 110% width and 110vh height, overflowing the screen, while the corners go to 0 (no curve, scrub 1 so it trails by 1 second). The image inside comes closer from 1.3x to 1x over the same span (same scrub). At 1024px and below it starts at 90% and 16:10 with the 30vw corner and grows to 100% and 100svh.

options.to-sp: Widened width at 1024px and below, default 100%
options.height-sp: Extended height at 1024px and below, default 100svh
options.scrub: Delay (sec) for the window to follow scroll, default 1
options.[data-fx-part=image]: (If present) photo or video inside the window — 1.3 → 1
options.end: Length it stays stuck (ScrollTrigger type, e.g. ‹+=250%”), as tall as the base panel — brand runs to the end of the 350svh wrapper
options.image-scrub: Delay (seconds) for the inner image following scroll, default true (no delay) — Brand 1.5
options.ratio: css: Measures the initial window height by the window’s css aspect-ratio — when the ratio differs per width (Brand phone 9:16)

from.where: index.html .top-about__brand__wrapper (boat photo at the end of About — original main.js Top module: figure height clientWidth/(16/9) → 110% · 110vh · borderRadius 0vw, pin · scrub 1, image scale 1 scrub true)

index.html .ws-concept__window (concept video window — original Top module: a 40vw·16:9 (9:16 at 575 and below) mask stays pinned until the end of the 350svh wrapper while growing to width 100% · height innerHeight with scrub 1.5, video scale 2 → 1 scrub 1.5)
